sources.title: Instantiation-based Formalization of Logical Reasoning Tasks Using Language Models and Logical Solvers
sources.verified_claim: Concrete semantic instantiation checks and repair; general accuracy, verification precision and verification coverage (verified subset) are already reported.
sources.paper_scope: Candidate-set reference matching G is a different coverage definition; no claim to invent precision/coverage separation.

sources.title: Automating Requirements Formalization: Using LLMs and Low-Complexity Distinguishing Traces for Semantic Validation
sources.venue: 48th IEEE/ACM International Conference on Software Engineering
sources.verified_claim: Distinguishing traces, semantic validation, formalization accuracy and validation effort.
sources.paper_scope: Finite-pool automated judge is an adaptation, not reproduction of human-assisted validation.

sources.title: A Reality Check of Language Models as Formalizers on Constraint Satisfaction Problems
sources.verified_claim: Compares language models as formalizers and solvers across constraint-satisfaction tasks; formalization bottlenecks.
sources.paper_scope: Prior diagnosis acknowledged; no blanket claim formalization is always worse.

sources.title: On the Effect of Sampling Diversity in Scaling LLM Inference
sources.verified_claim: Perturbation-based diversity, verifier dependence and majority-voting limitations; Section 5.2 explicitly distinguishes pass@k from selected outcomes.
sources.paper_scope: Coverage not implying selected correctness is a precedent, not an original observation here.

sources.title: VERGE: Formal Refinement and Guidance Engine for Verifiable LLM Reasoning
sources.verified_claim: Equivalence consensus, semantic alignment, solver feedback, routing; Section 4.1 compute parity and Appendix E.4 formalization funnel/failure taxonomy.
sources.paper_scope: Explicit precedent for pipeline diagnostics and accounting; our narrower request-level joint G/S and benchmark-opportunity link is a position.
